comments.text: Wyoming, amazingly, also contained part of the Republic of Texas. When Texas was annexed, it had a long, thin panhandle that went all the way across Colorado and into Wyoming. It also claimed the southern Colorado, the Oklahoma Panhandle (of course) and all of New Mexico east of the Rio Grande. Fortunately the Compromise of 1850 cut it down to its modern size in exchange for the US paying off the debts of the Republic of Texas.
